title: Duecare harness chat — wheels
subtitle: v3.17 omni harness chat: 5 toggles + 4 grade modes + 9 model variants
description: v3.17 / chat-package 0.3.3 (2026-05-07) — 21-dim rubric, use-case-aware analog prompt classifier (multi-lingual: en/tl/id/ne/bn/my/ar/es/vi/si/ta/ur), curator-block JSON governance. v0.3.3: dead-code purge — removed orphan ablation function (~140 JS lines), readGenerationFromUI helper, renderAblationPanel, render-chat hook, and the /api/ablation server endpoint (~125 Python lines). Net wheel size unchanged but the trace-modal latency budget now correctly enumerates the 6 active layers without the dead 7th. Carries v0.3.2 polish (AbortController, tooltips, probing state, mobile tables), v0.3.0 Brave BYOK, v0.2.9 server-side import + ZIP. GREP rule set now ships 111 rules across 16 categories, including v3.17 digital-era additions for QR/mobile-wallet payment plans, side-letter two-contract deception, and digital credential-vault debt control. RAG corpus now ships 35 docs, including digital fee collection and side-letter deception briefs. Bundled wheels: duecare-llm-chat, duecare-llm-core, duecare-llm-models. Single CORE entry point: one configurable interface wiring every harness layer + 9 model variants (Gemma 4 E2B / E4B / 26B-A4B / 31B / 2 abliterated jailbroken / 3 cloud BYOK routes). Updates land here - bump this dataset version to refresh attached notebooks.
